Plantable Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly – 12 Seed-Paper Cards, DIY MDF Stand

The Plantable Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly is one of the most innovative and sustainable desk accessories designed for conscious consumers and modern workplaces. Made from premium MDF and paired with 12 seed-paper cards (3.5″×5″), this eco-positive product allows you to enjoy a functional calendar that transforms into fresh plants once the month ends. Each card is embedded with tomato, basil, and marigold seeds, making it a perfect choice for people looking for eco-friendly gifts, sustainable corporate gifting options, and plantable stationery.

This eco-friendly plantable calendar comes with a DIY MDF stand featuring a smooth finish and an integrated pen/pencil slot for added utility. The calendar is ideal for office desks, home workspaces, events, employee welcome kits, and CSR activities. With more companies embracing sustainability, this innovative product stands out as a memorable and meaningful alternative to traditional paper calendars.

Why Choose a Plantable Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly?

The world is shifting towards sustainability, and the Plantable Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly helps promote an environmentally conscious lifestyle. Instead of contributing to paper waste, every seed-paper card can be planted after use, supporting a greener planet. This makes it a highly preferred choice for corporate gifts, employee joining kits, eco-friendly promotional items, and environmental awareness campaigns.

The compact size of the 12 seed-paper cards (3.5″×5″) ensures they fit comfortably on any desk, while the DIY MDF stand allows easy assembly and long-term use. With seeds carefully selected for Indian climate conditions—tomato, basil, and marigold—users experience high germination success and the joy of nurturing new plants.

Key Features

  • Eco-Friendly Plantable Calendar (MDF) with reusable wooden stand
  • Includes 12 seed-paper cards (3.5″×5″)—one for each month
  • Cards embedded with tomato, basil & marigold seeds
  • DIY MDF stand with integrated pen/pencil slot
  • Smooth, premium-quality MDF for durable desk use
  • Seed-paper cards are 100% biodegradable and chemical-free
  • Step-by-step planting instructions included
  • Ideal for eco-friendly corporate gifts and plantable stationery
  • Great for employee welcome kits, exhibitions, events & giveaways
  • Supports sustainability, zero-waste living & green initiatives

How It Works

Using the Plantable Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly is both simple and rewarding. Once a month is over, tear the seed-paper card into pieces, soak it in water, and plant it in soil. Keep the soil moist and place it in sunlight. Within a few days, the seeds begin to sprout, allowing every user to contribute to a greener environment. This unique zero-waste concept makes the product stand out among other sustainable corporate gifts.

Perfect for Corporate Gifting & Personal Use

Businesses searching for meaningful and eco-conscious gifting options will find this plantable desk calendar extremely valuable. It is widely used for corporate gifting, brand promotions, festive hampers, employee joining kits, client appreciation gifts, and eco-friendly merchandise. Individuals also love it as a thoughtful gift for family, teachers, colleagues, and nature lovers.

Choose the Plantable Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly to promote sustainability while adding charm and purpose to any workspace. It not only organizes your days but also gives life to new plants—turning every month into a green celebration.
